findings.title: Meta Title
findings.detail: No meta title (SEO title) set — search engines will improvise one from the page. The rendered <title> looks fine (theme fallback) — set the field to control it.
findings.fix: Add a clear, descriptive meta title in the SEO fields.

findings.title: Meta Description
findings.detail: No meta description — Google will generate a snippet from page text, which may be weak.
findings.fix: Write a concise summary that gives users a reason to click.

findings.title: Internal Linking
findings.detail: No internal links — readers (and crawlers) have no path to your other pages.
findings.fix: Link to related services or guides where it helps the reader.
